title: ssGSEA3.0: single-sample gene set enrichment analysis with feature-level bootstrap resampling
description: ssGSEA3.0 is an R package for single-sample Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (ssGSEA) of gene-centric data and PTM-Signature Enrichment Analysis (PTM-SEA) of site-centric phosphoproteomics data. It replaces the gene-label permutation testing of ssGSEA2.0 with feature-level (gene- or site-level) bootstrap resampling, which remains calibrated across weighting schemes while retaining detection power. The package includes the worked examples and bundled results from the accompanying manuscript.
